color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FIF data — raw.get_data()
• all channels → copied unchanged into sub-…_meg.fif
• raw.n_times, raw.first_samp → RecordingDuration, event onsets and samples

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
File name raw.filenames[0]
• extension .fif → Manufacturer 'Elekta' (MNE-BIDS lookup table)
• extension .fif → MEGCoordinateSystem 'ElektaNeuromag', units 'm'

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FIF info — recording (raw.info[...])
• info['sfreq'] → SamplingFrequency, sampling_frequency, event onsets
• info['line_freq'] → PowerLineFrequency (MNE-BIDS stops if the key is missing)
• info['meas_date'] → scans.tsv acq_time, participants age
(and the session label for the sub-emptyroom layout)
• info['highpass'] → channels.tsv low_cutoff (0.0 = MNE default)
• info['lowpass'] → channels.tsv high_cutoff (600.0 = Nyquist default)
• info['comps'] → SoftwareFilters GradientOrder (0 = no compensation)
• info['subject_info'] → participants.tsv age, sex, hand, weight, height

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FIF info — channels (raw.info['chs'][i], raw.info['bads'])
• info['chs'][i]['ch_name'] → channels.tsv name
• info['chs'][i]['coil_type'], then ['kind'] → channels.tsv type
• info['chs'][i]['kind'] → _meg.json channel counts, channels.tsv description
• info['chs'][i]['unit'] → channels.tsv units (T; V for stim and misc)
• info['bads'] → channels.tsv status

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FIF info — digitisation (subject runs only)
• info['dig'] NAS, LPA, RPA → DigitizedLandmarks,
coordsystem AnatomicalLandmarkCoordinates and HeadCoilCoordinates
• info['dig'] head-shape points → DigitizedHeadPoints

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FIF info — not read by MNE-BIDS
Copied into the BIDS FIF only; no sidecar uses them:
• info['device_info'] = {'type': 'Cerca', 'model': 'cMEG'}
• info['experimenter'] (operator name), info['description']
• info['dev_head_t'], info['chs'][i]['loc'], info['chs'][i]['coord_frame']
• info['gantry_angle'], info['hpi_*'], info['projs'], info['proc_history']

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
write_raw_bids() arguments (set in the notebook)
• bids_path: sub, ses, task, run, root → file names, TaskName,
scans.tsv filename, participant_id
• events: array from mne.find_events(raw, 'STI101') → events.tsv onset, sample, value
(without events, MNE-BIDS uses raw.annotations instead)
• event_id: name → code → events.tsv trial_type
• empty_room: BIDSPath of the task-noise run → AssociatedEmptyRoom
• overwrite, allow_preload, format → how the files are written

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
dataset_description.json
MNE-BIDS default (re-added each time write_raw_bids runs):
• Name = '[Unspecified]' — REQUIRED: placeholder, give the dataset a name
• BIDSVersion = '1.9.0' (REQUIRED, filled), DatasetType = 'raw'
• Authors = ['[Unspecified1]', '[Unspecified2]'] — RECOMMENDED unless CITATION.cff lists them
• GeneratedBy = MNE-BIDS 0.20.0
Not written:
• License — RECOMMENDED: fill

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

p.span: • reference list only (MNE-BIDS and MEG-BIDS papers) — README is RECOMMENDED: describe the dataset

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
participants.tsv + participants.json
From the arguments:
• participant_id ← bids_path.subject
From the FIF:
• age ← info['subject_info'] birthday + info['meas_date']; sex, hand, weight, height ← info['subject_info']
• age, sex, hand, weight, height all n/a (subject_info is empty) — OPTIONAL: fill from your records
MNE-BIDS default:
• participants.json = stock text for the 6 columns

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

p.span: • CHANGES — OPTIONAL: version history of the dataset
• CITATION.cff — OPTIONAL: how to cite; if present, it replaces Authors in dataset_description.json
• task-<label>_meg.json — OPTIONAL: top-level sidecar, inherited by every recording of the task

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
sub-…_meg.fif (split-01, split-02, … above 2 GB)
From the FIF:
• data ← FIF data, unchanged
• header ← all of FIF info, including in-memory edits made before writing

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
sub-…_meg.json
From the FIF:
• SamplingFrequency ← info['sfreq']
• PowerLineFrequency ← info['line_freq']
• RecordingDuration ← time of the last sample
• MEGChannelCount, MEGREFChannelCount, MiscChannelCount,
TriggerChannelCount, EEG/EOG/ECG/EMGChannelCount ← info['chs'][i]['kind']
• DigitizedLandmarks ← info['dig'] fiducials
• DigitizedHeadPoints ← info['dig'] head-shape points
From the arguments:
• TaskName ← bids_path.task
• AssociatedEmptyRoom ← empty_room — RECOMMENDED: plain path is deprecated, use a bids:: URI
MNE-BIDS default:
• Manufacturer = 'Elekta' (from the .fif extension) — RECOMMENDED: for MEG must be one of the BIDS list → 'Other'
• DewarPosition = 'n/a' — REQUIRED: set 'upright', 'supine' or an angle
• SoftwareFilters = {'SpatialCompensation': {'GradientOrder': 0}} — REQUIRED: describes a CTF filter; set 'n/a' or the real filters
• RecordingType = 'continuous'
Not written:
• ManufacturersModelName, SoftwareVersions, DeviceSerialNumber, HardwareFilters — RECOMMENDED: fill
• TaskDescription, Instructions, InstitutionName / Address / DepartmentName — RECOMMENDED: fill
• ContinuousHeadLocalization, HeadCoilFrequency (written only for Elekta, CTF, KIT; no head coils on OPM)

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
sub-…_channels.tsv (one row per channel)
From the FIF:
• name ← info['chs'][i]['ch_name']
• type ← coil_type first, then kind — REQUIRED: 3N/3O reference sensors come out MEGMAG, set MEGREFMAG
• units ← info['chs'][i]['unit'] (T for MEG and reference, V for stim and misc)
• low_cutoff ← info['highpass'] — OPTIONAL: 0.0 is a default, not a filter
• high_cutoff ← info['lowpass'] — OPTIONAL: 600.0 is Nyquist, not a filter
• sampling_frequency ← info['sfreq']
• status ← info['bads']
MNE-BIDS default:
• description = generic text per type ('Magnetometer', 'Trigger', …)
• status_description = n/a
Not written: notch, software_filters columns; _channels.json

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
sub-…_coordsystem.json (one per session, no task entity)
From the FIF:
• AnatomicalLandmarkCoordinates ← info['dig'] NAS, LPA, RPA
• HeadCoilCoordinates ← the same fiducials (OPMs have no head coils)
MNE-BIDS default (from the .fif extension):
• MEGCoordinateSystem, HeadCoilCoordinateSystem,
AnatomicalLandmarkCoordinateSystem = 'ElektaNeuromag'
• MEGCoordinateUnits, HeadCoilCoordinateUnits,
AnatomicalLandmarkCoordinateUnits = 'm'
• MEGCoordinateSystemDescription = stock text for ElektaNeuromag

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
sub-…_events.tsv + _events.json (task runs only)
From the arguments (with the FIF timing):
• onset ← (events sample − raw.first_samp) / info['sfreq']
• sample ← events sample − raw.first_samp
• value ← events code
• trial_type ← event_id name for that code
MNE-BIDS default:
• duration = 0 (impulse events)
• _events.json = stock column descriptions, no Levels

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
sub-…_scans.tsv (one row per file in the session)
From the arguments:
• filename ← bids_path (each split file listed)
From the FIF:
• acq_time ← info['meas_date'] (n/a if missing)

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Empty-room run (task-noise)
• same files from the same rules, except:
• no _events.tsv / _events.json
• no AssociatedEmptyRoom
• DigitizedLandmarks / DigitizedHeadPoints = false (no --dig)

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
Legend
Red: BIDS REQUIRED, and MNE-BIDS writes a placeholder or a wrong value.
Uses BIDS schema v1.11.2, MEG section. You must set them.
Yellow: BIDS RECOMMENDED or OPTIONAL, and wrong or empty.
You should correct or fill them.
No highlight: filled correctly by MNE-BIDS, or optional and fine left out.
REQUIRED / RECOMMENDED / OPTIONAL are BIDS levels, not MNE-BIDS rules. MNE-BIDS itself only needs
a .fif file, an info['line_freq'] entry, and meas_date for the sub-emptyroom layout.
